author: HorrorR
body:
Before I start I want to apologise if my english is not the best or I can't get the point across

So yeah. This idea would help the server to keep people active and the players to have something to work hard to achieve

Is kinda easy and self-explanatory, based on the Monthly stats, name an user "Player of the Month"

It can also be divided into special achievements: "Killer of the month" (the user with most kills), "Rusher of the month" (the user with most objectives), "Farmer of the month" (The highiest KD ratio)

The winner should get a reward like a special rank or a web badge that lasts for a month, until the next winners are anounced

It can also be applied to competitive events, like a "Tourney MVP"

If you have any extra ideas or suggestions, or things to modify, please post them below
